one_liner: Plaid has a broad REST API with a free Sandbox for everyone; the free Production Trial is limited to US/CA signups, and full production needs approval.
auth_notes: Core API uses client_id and secret sent with each request, plus per-user access_tokens obtained through Plaid Link. OAuth client_credentials via /oauth/token is only documented for the Dashboard MCP, which is narrow, so it is not primary. This was not re-verifiable in the supplied pages.
access_notes: Sandbox is free for all developers and supports all Plaid functionality. US/CA developers who sign up on or after April 15, 2026 can get an auto-approved free Trial plan with real data, capped at 10 Production Items. Full Production needs approval, which takes a few business days.
blocker_notes: Sandbox is free and unlimited, so a toolkit can be built and tested without approval. The Trial plan adds free real-data access for US/CA developers. Full Production approval takes a few business days but does not block building.

evidence.quote: These models only apply to Production traffic; usage of Sandbox is always free.

The [Sandbox](https://plaid.com/docs/quickstart/glossary/#sandbox) is a free environment for application development and testing with mock data. It supports all Plaid functionality, including the [Plaid API](https://plaid.com/docs/) and Plaid Link.
The Plaid Trial plan provides free access to Plaid's production APIs.
Explore server-side API libraries and integrate with API endpoints
you must first create an OAuth token with the scope `mcp:dashboard` and the `client_credentials` grant type via the [`/oauth/token`](/docs/api/oauth/#oauthtoken) API.
The **Dashboard MCP server** is a remote MCP server hosted by Plaid. It provides Production diagnostics and analytics tools
